Explore your tasks and responsibilities You are responsible for the planning, design, and cost estimation of electrical systems in high-tech facilities within the semiconductor or BioPharma and Life Science industry You develop concepts for all project phases of the design (Concept Design, Basic Design, Detail Design) and possess strong communication skills and expertise to convincingly represent them to our clients You define the necessary documents (e.g. specifications, drawings, functional descriptions, technical specifications, bill of quantities) and are responsible for their creation In your role, you are accountable for budget, quality and scheduling requirements, and support project management in developing and potentially adjusting the project schedule You create assignments for subcontractors, monitor and control their execution, ensuring the highest quality of implementation and compliance with safety, health and environmental protection requirements You define and coordinate interfaces, ensuring a reliable flow of information internally and externally You participate in meetings, factory acceptance test and on-site acceptance tests You accompany the installation of electrical systems Show your expertise You have successfully completed a degree in electrical engineering or possess another equivalent technical education You have at least 5 years of professional experience in the planning, construction, maintenance, or commissioning of electrical systems You are proficient in common PC programs and MS Office applications Ideally, you have experience in the field of high-tech facilities, such as the semiconductor or BioPharma industry, and knowledge of specific design and calculations, including: Lighting calculations (DIALUX, Relux) for normal and emergency lighting Planning of cable routing systems (ladders, cable trays, etc.) Planning of busbars including junction boxes for power distribution Lightning protection and surge
